'''2001 Washington State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Washington in 2001. [[Nick Jones]] won it.<ref name="dt-16032">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16032 Golden], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 18 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16032/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16032/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 21 April 2001<ref name="tr-d2128" />
* '''Site:''' Washington; Broken Games, Lake City, Washington<ref name="tr-d2128" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Nick Jones]]
* '''Players:''' 49<ref name="tr-d2139" />

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Keith Watabayashi went 3–0 with his Dark ISB space deck, beating Derek Snook's and Michael Fortman's Watch Your Step decks and Matt Bryant's Ketwol HDWGITM deck, and 1–2 with his Light deck, a spin-off of Holman's DPC deck, losing to the eventual winner Nick Jones and the eventual runner-up [[Douglas Harvilla]], both with Hunt Down. Harvilla posted his Light Watch Your Step deck from the event as "2nd Place WA States".<ref name="dt-15478" /> He was 4–1 with +89 differential before losing the last game of the normal tournament to Harvilla.<ref name="dt-16032" /><ref name="dt-16098" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Reports differ on the field size: Michael Fortman says 49 people attended, Greg Otte says 48 and Douglas Harvilla says he was the only undefeated player out of 47 after the Swiss rounds.<ref name="tr-d2139" />
